content.title: Modify a working Python program
content.summary: Trace inputs, variables, functions and errors by changing a working script before studying syntax systematically.

content.title: Clean imperfect tabular data
content.summary: Inspect types, missing values, duplicates and joins; make explicit data-quality decisions.

content.title: Arrays and vectorized computation
content.summary: Compare Python loops with array operations, shapes and broadcasting to understand computational structure.

content.title: Interrogate data visually
content.summary: Choose plots from questions, record observations, and distinguish patterns from artifacts before modeling.

content.title: Reproducible ML pipelines
content.summary: Bind preprocessing and modeling so training and inference use the same transformations and leakage is visible.

content.title: Classical supervised and unsupervised ML
content.summary: Regression, classification, trees, ensembles, neighbors and clustering through prediction, diagnostics and evaluation.

content.title: Vectors, probability, gradients and optimization on demand
content.summary: Use mathematics to explain observed model behavior, descending only to the mechanism currently blocking progress.

content.title: Neural-network mechanisms and training
content.summary: Open neurons, forward passes, backpropagation, autograd and failure diagnosis after first training a complete network.

content.title: Tokens, embeddings, attention and transformers
content.summary: Trace how text becomes tokens and vectors, how attention changes context, and how transformer blocks process representations.

content.title: LLM training, inference and adaptation
content.summary: Map training objectives, inference controls and adaptation choices to system behavior and constraints.

content.title: Semantic search service
content.summary: Embed documents and queries, retrieve by similarity, evaluate misses and understand the retrieval boundary.

content.title: Grounded generation with RAG
content.summary: Retrieve evidence before generation, preserve provenance, inspect retrieval misses and separate retrieval from answer quality.

content.title: Reranking, chunking and retrieval evaluation
content.summary: Improve retrieval through experiments with candidate generation, reranking, chunk boundaries, metrics and failure analysis.

content.title: Tool use and stateful agent workflows
content.summary: Use explicit tools, state transitions, contracts and deterministic control where possible; add memory, routing and fallbacks deliberately.

content.title: Evaluate AI systems systematically
content.summary: Define behavioral datasets, graders, failure taxonomies and observable system-level metrics before trusting agent performance.

content.title: Integrated AI system architecture
content.summary: Design and defend boundaries among models, retrieval, tools, memory, deterministic logic, evaluation, reliability and observability.
